messages.subject: LDLT Factorizations
parts:
I'm about to push a bunch of changes which I will describe in a series
of emails. The work, done over the past week or so, come together to
make Stan much faster in a number of ways (any models using multI_* or
*wishart distributions should be much faster), and in particular,
greatly improves the ability to work with Gaussian Process models.

Without further ado...

1) LDLT_factor

I've introduced an LDLT_factor<T> class and a set of functions which
use it, i.e., log_determinant_ldlt, mdivide_left_ldlt,
mdivide_right_ldlt. This is a C++ only interface.

This class ensures that any function which uses the above operations
on a symmetric, positive definite matrix only ever needs to compute
the decomposition once, including to perform the positive-definiteness
check. Now, as a rule, check_pos_definite should never be used unless
that is the *only* use. If any of the above operations will be needed
on that matrix, use LDLT_factor instead.

I've gone through and updated the multi_gp_log, multi_normal_log,
multi_student_t_log, wishart_log and inv_wishart_log functions to make
use of it. I'm not sure if there are any other potential targets or
not, feel free to let me know if I've missed anything.

This code is not the prettiest and will probably be cleaned up a bit
over time, and some more thorough error checking included. In the
meantime let me know if you have any comments on the code or design.

Cheers,
Marcus
